examShortTricks: Trick 1: Three stories = three lessons: connecting dots (trust that experiences connect), love and loss (do what you love), death (live each day as your last) — structure every answer around the three.
Trick 2: 'Stay hungry, stay foolish' — the closing motto; explain what each half means (never complacent; take risks).
Trick 3: The 'dots' metaphor: you can only connect them looking BACKWARDS, so trust in the future — the most-quoted line; use it in theme answers.
practiceQuestions: Q. What are the three stories Jobs tells? (3 marks) — connecting the dots; love and loss; death.
Q. What does 'stay hungry, stay foolish' mean? (2 marks) — keep ambition and curiosity alive; dare to take risks.
keyPoints: Three stories: dots (trust the future), love (do what you love), death (live each day fully).
'Stay hungry, stay foolish' — memorise this closing for theme questions.
